basic_details.job_title: UPPSC Civil Judge PCS J Recruitment 2026 - Notification Out (Short) for 365 Civil Judge Posts
basic_details.short_information: Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission (UPPSC) has released the abridged advertisement for the U.P. Judicial Service Civil Judge (Junior Division) Examination 2026. A total of 365 Civil Judge vacancies have been announced under Advertisement No. A-6/E-1/2026. The online application process starts on 20 November 2026, and the last date to apply online and pay the examination fee is 21 December 2026.

application_fee.details: The last date for examination fee payment in the bank is 21 December 2026. Candidates should ensure that the fee payment and application submission are completed by the prescribed deadline.

age_limit.details: Age Criteria Details Minimum Age 22 Years Maximum Age 35 Years Age Calculation Date 1 July 2027 Earliest Eligible Date of Birth 2 July 1992 Latest Eligible Date of Birth 1 July 2005 | Eligible candidates must have been born between 2 July 1992 and 1 July 2005, inclusive, subject to applicable age relaxation rules.

qualification.details: Candidates must meet the educational qualification, age limit and other eligibility requirements prescribed by UPPSC for the Judicial Service Civil Judge (Junior Division) Examination 2026. | Candidates should check the detailed notification for the required law qualification, professional eligibility conditions and any additional requirements before applying. Qualifications from earlier recruitment cycles should not be assumed to apply unchanged to the 2026 examination. | Eligible candidates must have been born between 2 July 1992 and 1 July 2005, inclusive, subject to applicable age relaxation rules. | Relaxation in the maximum age limit is permissible for eligible persons with disabilities and candidates belonging to specified categories of Uttar Pradesh, as prescribed in the recruitment rules.

how_to_apply: Eligible candidates can submit their applications online through the official Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission website. The application process begins on 20 November 2026.
Visit the official UPPSC website at https://uppsc.up.nic.in/.
Find the notification for the U.P. Judicial Service Civil Judge (Junior Division) Examination 2026, Advertisement No. A-6/E-1/2026.
Download and read the detailed advertisement carefully.
Check the educational qualification, age limit, reservation conditions and other eligibility requirements.
Open the relevant online application link and follow the registration and application instructions displayed on the official portal.
Enter the required information accurately and upload documents in the prescribed format, wherever applicable.
Pay the applicable examination fee using the payment procedure specified by UPPSC.
Review the entered details and submit the application before 21 December 2026.
Save a copy of the completed application and fee payment confirmation for future reference.

UPPSC has provided until 28 December 2026 for correction or modification of submitted applications and fee reconciliation. Candidates should consult the detailed notification for the permitted corrections and relevant procedures.

content_sections.heading: UP Judiciary Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The Uttar Pradesh Public Service Commission has announced 365 vacancies for the Civil Judge (Junior Division) post. The commission has stated that the total number of vacancies may increase or decrease depending on administrative requirements and circumstances.

content_sections.heading: UPPSC Civil Judge PCS J Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the educational qualification, age limit and other eligibility requirements prescribed by UPPSC for the Judicial Service Civil Judge (Junior Division) Examination 2026. Candidates should check the detailed notification for the required law qualification, professional eligibility conditions and any additional requirements before applying. Qualifications from earlier recruitment cycles should not be assumed to apply unchanged to the 2026 examination. Eligible candidates must have been born between 2 July 1992 and 1 July 2005, inclusive, subject to applicable age relaxation rules. Relaxation in the maximum age limit is permissible for eligible persons with disabilities and candidates belonging to specified categories of Uttar Pradesh, as prescribed in the recruitment rules.
